snippet.title: Half Mermaid on PRECOGNITION | Kinetic Publishing
snippet.description:
Learn more about PRECOGNITION, the latest game from Half Mermaid - creators of Her Story and IMMORTALITY.

Originally teased as ‘Project C’, PRECOGNITION follows in the footsteps of Sam Barlow’s previous game, IMMORTALITY, combining cinematic live-action sequences with non-linear storytelling and a focus on player freedom and agency. Players take on the role of Diana, a woman who discovers she can receive visions of the future after an experimental implant is embedded into her brain.

Players will be tasked with exploring these visions of the future, focusing on specific moments and committing them to Diana’s memory in the present day. Prescience comes with consequences, however, and as soon as Diana commits a detail to memory, the very future ahead of her changes.

PRECOGNITION launches on PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 in Spring 2028.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771630/precognition/
